title: Envisioning Hindsight: published forecasts, graded against what happened
description:
Hindsight is a public record of published forecasts about the future, checked against what happened. Each forecast is a dated claim with a named source and a stable id, graded with cited evidence; every change to a grade stays in the record.

The data in data/out (JSON, CSV, JSON Schemas, datapackage.json) is licensed CC BY 4.0, except rows derived from data/raw/bcb-focus, which are ODbL 1.0. The code is MIT licensed. See NOTICE.md.

Site: envisioning.com/hindsight
notes: Code: MIT. Data: CC BY 4.0 (Banco Central do Brasil Focus rows: ODbL 1.0).
